sources.name: background
sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5travel puzzle PAINTED CLEAN BACKGROUND. Scene: A rose-covered pergola in an intimate garden. View: wide intimate view from slightly above. Polished warm storybook digital painting matching the approved Art Direction V2 game boards: tactile softly brushed surfaces, gentle sunlight, dimensional illustrated objects, clean local colour separation and rich small discoveries. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. Dominant main colour: berry red (#B85466), clearly occupying the largest coherent surfaces, with balanced contrasting details. Composition is generic travel subject matter; NO recognizable destination landmarks, city names, signs, letters or logos. No UI or border. This is a finished clean plate for five separately painted motion details. Paint complete underlying surfaces at all five declared positions; do not draw the five named foreground details, leave no transparent hole or blank placeholder. Portrait master1280x1600. Part placements for later composition: an upper-left branch of the scene-specific plant at normalised rect [0.07, 0.09, 0.23, 0.2]; an upper-right leaf cluster of a different scene plant at normalised rect [0.72, 0.14, 0.2, 0.2]; a lower-left flower or fern frond at normalised rect [0.08, 0.69, 0.21, 0.22]; a lower-right cluster of matching grass or foliage at normalised rect [0.71, 0.72, 0.22, 0.18]; a small soft cloud or reflected-water glint suited to this scene at normalised rect [0.4, 0.27, 0.2, 0.12]. The painting must remain attractive and complete underneath those parts.
MANDATORY FULLY OPAQUE RGB painting with alpha255 everywhere; no transparent regions or translucent painted background. Refinement: An intimate rose-covered pergola with rich berry-red roses filling much of the scene, berry-red painted timber posts and a berry red garden bench beneath, muted leafy greens secondary. Old pale stone path leads through. No dramatic famous garden, mansion, person, letters or ornaments. Refined dimensional softly brushed petals, coherent timber structure. Deep wine/berry main palette clearly different from green grocer. Preserve clean underlying foliage and sky for tiny separate parts. No UI, border, logo or lettering. This is a fully finished clean plate, portrait4:5.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA production sprite atlas, 1536x1024, invisible 3-column by2-row layout. Exactly five distinct purpose-painted full objects, one centered inside each of the first five 512x512 cells; last bottom-right cell totally empty. Every object SMALL, maximum280x300pixels, huge alpha gutters, nothing crosses x512,x1024,y512, no visible grid. All background pixels alpha0, genuine holes between leaves/threads, no glow, haze, contact-shadow field, backdrop, labels or scenery. Detailed dimensional warm storybook digital painting matching approved Art Direction V2 game painting: natural tactile materials, soft brushwork, gentle light from upper-left; no flat vector clipart. For a berry-red rose-covered pergola: upper-left one rich dark-berry rose flower with short curved stem and one leaf; upper-middle a DIFFERENT smaller half-open crimson rosebud on a long fine stem with two leaves; upper-right one rose-leaf twig with three muted green serrated leaves and bare lower stem; lower-left a small warm ivory-peach cloud for the open distant sky; lower-middle one tiny pale-cream butterfly with gold/tan markings. No pergola, foliage field, sky rectangle or ground. Fully separate complete shapes. Do not paint any object touching image or cell boundaries.
